🗣️ Teacher Demo & Pair Guide — How to Reply Politely (Worksheet Part 2):
👆 Click to Reveal / Hide
✍️ How Should We Say It? Tap to Build: [ care ] + [ way to cope ] + [ suggestion ]
Reveal ▾
1. [ care ], ... (Be polite & warm — don't scold rudely!)
2. ...but we should [ way to cope ] because [ reason ].
3. Let's [ suggestion ] instead! (Distract with a safe place or sport!)
"I care about you, but we should avoid quiet places because being alone in a quiet place is unsafe. Let's go to a bright public café instead!"
🛡️ 4 Ways to Cope (Write These on Worksheet Part 2)
Reveal ▾
• Set limits of intimacy (e.g. respect my limits)
• Stay away from pornography (e.g. turn off 18+ video)
• Avoid quiet places (e.g. go to a public café / library)
• Join healthy activities (e.g. play basketball / sports / cycle)
